description: This Java class represents MQTT command subscriptions within the Eclipse Hono framework. It parses MQTT topic filters to extract subscription details such as tenant, device ID, endpoint, QoS, and other metadata. It also provides factory methods to create subscription instances from topic strings or MQTT subscription requests, handling authentication context.

classes.name: CommandSubscription
classes.description: Manages MQTT command subscription details, parsing topic filters, handling authentication context, and providing accessors for subscription metadata.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant associated with the subscription.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID associated with the subscription.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID of the authenticated device, if available.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the MQTT endpoint used in the subscription.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the QoS level of the MQTT subscription.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the MQTT connection.

methods.name: getRequestPart
methods.description: Returns the request part of the MQTT topic (e.g., 'req').

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Indicates whether the subscription is associated with an authenticated device.

methods.name: isGatewaySubscriptionForSpecificDevice
methods.description: Checks if this subscription pertains to a specific device on behalf of a gateway.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription from a topic string and optional authenticated device. Returns null if the topic pattern is invalid.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription from an MQTT topic subscription object, an optional authenticated device, and client ID. Returns null if the topic pattern is invalid.
